nodes.text: You! You walk, don't you? Everyone walks. I've two roads in my legs today and there's a *third*: word for Hale at the west post, then the Silver Flagon, up the capital. Can you take it? Say yes fast.
Hale first. Waykeeper, west road, lamp's always lit. Then Ragna at the Flagon. Don't ask her anything, she hears enough. I owe you! Probably a secret!
No time to be sad about it. Third road, here I come!
